name: Maximal Gradient Flow
algorithm: Maximal Gradient Flow — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes maximal gradient flow for image forensic analysis:

1. **梯度Field计算**: The full gradient vector field ∇I(x,y) = (∂I/∂x, ∂I/∂y) is computed across the image. The gradient magnitude and direction at each point characterize the local image structure.

2. **梯度FlowTracing**: Starting from each pixel, the maximal gradient ascent path is traced — following the direction of steepest intensity increase. These paths converge at local intensity maxima (peaks). The network of gradient flow paths reveals the image's topological structure.

3. **FlowConvergence分析**: In natural images, gradient flow paths show smooth convergence patterns consistent with continuous intensity surfaces. The method analyzes convergence patterns — AI-generated images may show anomalous convergence: flow paths that terminate prematurely, converge in non-physical patterns, or show grid-aligned artifacts from the generation architecture.

4. **Watershed-LikeSegmentation**: The gradient flow induces a natural segmentation of the image into basins of attraction (each associated with a local maximum). The shapes and boundaries of these basins reflect the image's natural structure. Generated images may show basin shapes inconsistent with the depicted scene physics.

5. **FlowTopology评分**: The topological complexity of the gradient flow field (number of critical points: maxima, minima, saddle points, and their spatial distribution) is analyzed. Natural images follow predictable topological statistics. The score measures deviation from expected gradient flow topology, flagging images with anomalous gradient structure.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： maximal gradient flow 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Canny, J. (1986). A Computational Approach to Edge Detection. IEEE TPAMI.
